run_create_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to convert ASE atoms directories into ASE database files for finetuning with train and val dirs
run_launch_processing: run launch_processing to parallelize writing ASE atoms objects from input files into chunked ASE database files
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from a training ASE database for energy normalization
compute_lin_ref: compute linear reference coefficients from atomic numbers and energies using least squares regression for element-wise energy fitting
write_ase_db: write ASE atoms objects with energy and force results to an ASE database file in parallel using multiprocessing
